scoring_rule.description: Continuous performance score from 0 to 100 based on weighted features. Model prediction is explicitly separate.

missing_feature_policy.justification: If 1 or 2 features are missing, remaining feature weights are proportionally scaled to sum to 1. If >2 are missing, the agency's performance cannot be reliably measured.

ranking_rule.justification: Ties in continuous scores are broken by prioritizing compliance adherence, then timeliness, reflecting core regulatory priorities.

classification_boundary.justification: 0.50 is the natural binary threshold. Epsilon of 0.05 flags any probability in [0.45, 0.55] as uncertain.
